answers.reason: The description does not include the vice president for studies among the members of the senate.
The budget planning round is led by the chancellor and does not list the vice president for studies.
The appointment committee is not mentioned as part of the duties of the vice president for studies.
The vice president for studies leads university-wide degree matters, not individual faculty councils.
The study commission belongs to the faculty level, whereas the vice president operates across the university.
Examination boards decide on individual students at the faculty level, outside the remit of the university-wide vice president.
Internal research funding is a faculty-level grant process.
Module revision is specific to a degree programme and not assigned to the vice president.
Laboratory equipment procurement is outside the portfolio of degree programmes and teaching quality.
Orientation week planning is a student and faculty concern rather than a direct duty of the vice president.
